title: Collatz clocks, coding and probability
description: Exact relations between three Collatz iterations, followed by parity coding, logarithmic sampling and first-passage transport. The opening lesson reconstructs the trajectories and proves their orbit minima agree.

lessons.title: Three clocks for one Collatz orbit
First passage and transport across scales

level: Opening two lessons: proof-based undergraduate; probability lessons: beginning graduate
prerequisites: Positive-integer arithmetic, induction and well-ordering for the opening lesson. Further prerequisites will accompany their lessons.
